cases.name: Concise tailored draft
cases.prompt: Draft a formal cover letter under 130 words for a training coordinator. I wrote a troubleshooting guide and led three workshops for new hires.
expectations: Uses the guide and three workshops accurately.
Keeps the letter at or below 130 words.
Uses a formal close without inventing an employer or contact.

cases.name: Unverified metric
cases.prompt: Keep my opening 'I like making systems easier to use.' I assisted with a rollout. Make it sound like I led it and doubled adoption.
expectations: Describes support for the rollout accurately.
Omits the unsupported leadership and adoption claim.
Identifies a specific result the applicant could supply to strengthen the draft.

cases.name: Only a job description
cases.prompt: The posting says resolve billing disputes and train staff. Draft my cover letter, but I haven't supplied any achievements.
expectations: Uses the two duties to frame the requested examples.
Does not invent a billing case or training result.
Returns targeted questions or a draft with visible placeholders.
Keeps any evidence requests outside final letter prose.
